faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Botify
faq.a1: Botify is a multi-messaging bot marketplace where you can create, buy, and sell autonomous bots for WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Email, Slack, and Instagram.
faq.q2: How do I create a bot?
faq.a2: Sign up as a Seller, go to the Dashboard, click 'Create New Bot', select your platform (Email, WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.), and fill in the platform-specific configuration. Each platform has different setup steps.
faq.a3: Yes! Once you create a bot, you can publish it to the marketplace with a custom price. Buyers can then purchase and access your bot with all its configurations and scripts.
faq.a4: Currently, Botify supports: Email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and Instagram. More platforms are coming soon.
faq.a5: Payments are processed securely through our payment system. When a buyer purchases your bot, funds are credited to your account after the transaction is completed.
faq.q6: Can I customize the bot behavior?
faq.a6: Absolutely! Each bot supports custom scripts and configurations. You can define response rules, templates, webhooks, and more depending on the platform.
faq.a7: Yes, you can create bots for free. Selling bots on the marketplace is also free. We may introduce premium features in the future.
faq.q8: How secure are my bot credentials?
faq.a8: All sensitive data is encrypted and stored securely. You have full control over your bot credentials and can revoke access at any time.
faq.q9: Can I update my bot after publishing?
faq.a9: Yes! You can edit your bot details, update configurations, and modify scripts even after publishing. Changes take effect immediately.
faq.a10: Check our documentation, contact support through the Contact page, or reach out to our team directly. We're here to help!
